# Graphify Project

## Overview
This project uses Graphify to extract code structure and relationships and generate a knowledge graph visualization.

## Project Results
- Code files processed: 38
- Graph nodes: 19,433
- Graph edges: 43,956
- Communities detected: 874
- Cross-community edges in aggregated visualization: 3,226

## Generated Files
- graphify-out/graph.html - Interactive graph visualization
- graphify-out/graph.json - Extracted graph data
- graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md - Graph analysis report

## How to Run
Install Graphify according to its official installation instructions, then run the extraction and clustering commands for your project.

## Notes
Community labels may use generic names if an AI labeling backend is unavailable.
